ambiguous_bodies.status: Upper loop visible; distinguishing lower return blends into printed background. No invariant class or key value.

unknowns.status: Dense overwritten whole-form cluster; segmentation/class unresolved, no accepted body count.

order_scope: Display order top/right/left; top-to-right is linguistically coherent, left is a separate question strip. Does not establish inscription order.

date.scope: Catalogue date only; no ordinary written date accepted. Address face and postal date not examined.

method: Manual source-to-atlas comparison with existing key, emerging language and catalogue visible. Nonblind proposals; no secondary transformation.
review: Separately tasked Codex (GPT-6-astra) compared all 34 source contexts, border strips, punctuation, capped ch and t allographs. Source corrections and one-body k/z alternative recorded, U1 retained without segmentation/count. Thirteen contexts revised and checked for retained ink. Nonblind AI source review, not independent human authentication.

prepublication_corrections.reason: Six visible bodies: plain curved u and open-arc s, no separate crossed-stem d or stacked-lobe l. Source correction, not a language repair.
Lower k/z distinguishing contour blends into printed illustration. Retain one-body ambiguity instead of choosing by syntax.
Closed pointed oval supports leaf-shaped G19=c, rather than right-open G13=s. Source correction, not a language repair.

limits: Invariant totals exclude A1 and unresolved U1; no complete body/mark inventory or accuracy measure.
